data.one_liner: A comprehensive charting library for creating cartesian, circular, and spark charts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a rich set of data visualization widgets including cartesian, circular, pyramid, funnel, and spark charts. Supports 30+ chart types, multi-axis configurations, tooltips, zooming, panning, and dynamic live updates.
use_when: You need to render complex or high-performance charts in a Flutter application.
You require advanced interactive features like zooming, panning, trackballs, and crosshairs.
You have a commercial license or qualify for the Syncfusion Community License.
avoid_when: You want a purely open-source package without any commercial licensing requirements.
You only need a trivial chart and want to minimize dependency size.
strengths: Supports over 30 chart types including specialized financial and statistical charts.
High performance and smooth animations for live updating data.
Extensive user interaction features like zooming, panning, and crosshairs.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial or free community license from Syncfusion.
Large feature set can add weight to the application.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Syncfusion license (commercial or free community).

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a popular open-source alternative for building highly customizable charts without commercial licensing concerns.
